notes: R80 targets consistency of monetary values across all system layers and contexts. PRIMARY evidence (E1, E3, E4, E5) establishes that financial outputs must align across billing contexts and that user-facing totals must match persisted amounts. E5 explicitly states that currency presentation must not override core pricing logic. CONTEXT evidence (E7, E8, E9, E10) reinforces related consistency concerns (monetary representation, rounding, source-of-truth ambiguity) but does not override the primary target. Key gaps include fraction handling specifications, rounding rules, and the complete audit visibility model. The requirement is primarily about establishing a single authoritative source for monetary data across all system representations. Filtered abstract or low-relevance operative statements: Financial outputs must align consistently across all billing contexts (reports, exported files, and billing records) | User-facing monetary totals must match persisted billing amounts exactly | Monetary values must be derived consistently across calculation, storage, and user-facing display
